  Wire { from: "surface.mode"; to: SetPropertyAdapter { path: "mapping.settings.deck_assignment"; value: DecksAssignment.CD } enabled: deckAssignmentProp.value == DecksAssignment.AB && !mapping.shift } // MOD
  Wire { from: "surface.mode"; to: SetPropertyAdapter { path: "mapping.settings.deck_assignment"; value: DecksAssignment.AB } enabled: deckAssignmentProp.value == DecksAssignment.CD && !mapping.shift } // MOD

CSI/Z1MK2/Z1MK2.qml.find:
surface: "surface.left"
    propertiesPath: mapping.propertiesPath + ".left"

    shift: mapping.shift
    eqModePushAction: eqModePushActionProp.value
    eqModeShiftPushAction: eqModeShiftPushActionProp.value
    stemsModePushAction: stemsModePushActionProp.value
    stemsModeShiftPushAction: stemsModeShiftPushActionProp.value
    channelFxPushAction: channelFxPushActionProp.value

CSI/Z1MK2/Z1MK2.qml.replace:
surface: "surface.left"
    propertiesPath: mapping.propertiesPath + ".left"
    loopButton: 1 // MOD: Shift + EQ-Mode-Taste = Loop setzen/beenden
    browserButton: 2 // MOD: Shift + Stems-Mode-Taste = Only Browser (Layout) - nur LED

    shift: mapping.shift
    eqModePushAction: eqModePushActionProp.value
    eqModeShiftPushAction: -1 // MOD: Taste mit Shift gehoert dem Loop
    stemsModePushAction: stemsModePushActionProp.value
    stemsModeShiftPushAction: -1 // MOD: mit Shift = Only Browser (Layout)
    channelFxPushAction: channelFxPushActionProp.value
    channelFxShiftPushAction: -1 // MOD: mit Shift = Seek/Sync aus dem Layout
    prelistenPushAction: prelistenPushActionProp.value
    prelistenShiftPushAction: prelistenShiftPushActionProp.value

CSI/Z1MK2/Z1MK2.qml.find:
surface: "surface.right"

CSI/Z1MK2/Z1MK2.qml.replace:
surface: "surface.right"
    propertiesPath: mapping.propertiesPath + ".right"
    loopButton: 2 // MOD: Shift + Stems-Mode-Taste = Loop setzen/beenden

    shift: mapping.shift
    eqModePushAction: eqModePushActionProp.value
    eqModeShiftPushAction: -1 // MOD: mit Shift ohne Funktion (LED aus)
    stemsModePushAction: stemsModePushActionProp.value
    stemsModeShiftPushAction: -1 // MOD: Taste mit Shift gehoert dem Loop
    channelFxPushAction: channelFxPushActionProp.value
    channelFxShiftPushAction: -1 // MOD: mit Shift = Seek/Sync aus dem Layout
    prelistenPushAction: prelistenPushActionProp.value
    prelistenShiftPushAction: prelistenShiftPushActionProp.value
